newsitem.title: FRANCE: Airborne French offical aid supplies up sharply in H1 1997.
newsitem.headline: Airborne French offical aid supplies up sharply in H1 1997.

text.p: France's Overseas Cooperation department said the volume of official humanitarian supplies shipped by air in the first six months of 1997 exceeded that for the whole of 1996.
January-June 1997 shipments totalled 386.3 tonnes compared to 361.7 tonnes in 1996, a spokeswoman for the department told Reuters.
"So far in 1997 we have responded to a good number of appeals for aid, organising nine Boeing 707F full-charter flights compared to seven in the whole of 1996."
The department also uses scheduled flights for shipments, she added.

"There are no plans at present to operate further full-freighter flights although we are currently preparing supplies for Guinea-Bissau pharmaceuticals to combat a cholera epidemic in the country and Uganda baby food which will fly out on scheduled flights later this week and next week." - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 gov- www.racs.com
